schema.receiptSemantics: A locally-passed label requires observed execution for this exact declaration/source/dependency tuple, successful checker result and recorded axiom-policy check. Timeout, unsupported axioms, missing output or a fixture receipt cannot pass. This says kernel/checker acceptance of an encoded statement, not semantic fidelity, external theorem reproduction or physical correctness.
